notes.cap: HEZE that can ever be issued across every deck; a unit of account inside the files, never a token
notes.awayHours: the most time a deck will catch up on when you come back
notes.secondsPerDay: how long a day is, in real seconds
notes.intervalDays: days between syndications; six months, the interplanetary interval
notes.proposalEvery: days between proposals arriving at the doors
notes.signChance: chance in a hundred that a custodian signs on a given day, when they are signing on their own
notes.deskLimit: proposals the desk holds before the oldest fall off
notes.staleAfter: days after which an unsigned proposal counts against the bank's health

text: The rulebook of the coven. Keep a changed copy in the browser through the editor in the quarter and the coven plays by it on its next load; write it into the yard and it plays by it for good.
